name: Raxio prospective Bouake data center site
notes: At Raxio's Grand-Bassam CIV1 launch coverage, the Ivorian digital minister was reported as promising Raxio future sites including Bouake after VITIB, Yamoussoukro, Korhogo and San Pedro. This is treated as a planned/prospective expansion signal in Bouake, Bandama Valley; no capacity or schedule was disclosed.

name: Novatech Ivory Coast, Bouake
notes: Yandex Maps lists Novatech Ivory Coast in Gbeke, Bouake, Vallee du Bandama with the feature/category 'Data center' and a local phone contact. No primary company source, technical specification, or capacity was found, so this should be treated as an unverified small/local facility listing.

name: Yamoussoukro Datacenter for public university / virtual university services
developer: Orange Cote d'Ivoire / Ministry of Communication, Digital Economy and Post / ANSUT
notes: Open Government Partnership IRM reporting for the 2016-2018 Cote d'Ivoire action plan says installation of several datacenters to house services was substantially implemented, with a work order for Orange Cote d'Ivoire to carry out work on the Yamoussoukro Datacenter and a government document indicating completion at that center. The related environmental report describes a Yamoussoukro technopole datacenter site as a fallback/DRP site for Grand-Bassam workloads.

name: Second National Data Center at Yamoussoukro innovation park
developer: Ministry of Digital Transition and Digitalization / Cybastion Institute of Technology
notes: DigitalMag reported the digital transition minister's April 29, 2026 statement that, after the national data center being built at VITIB/Grand-Bassam, the government wants to build a second facility of the same capacity at Yamoussoukro in an innovation park. The article gives the reference design as Tier III, 20,000 sqm, 2 x 400 racks, 1 MW power and more than 2,200 Tb of storage; EXIM primary sources separately confirm the $66.1m Cybastion-backed national data center financing and VITIB location for the first site.
